## The problem

<!-- Describe the situation you're stuck in, not the feature you've designed.
     "I can't tell which episodes I've already watched" is more useful than
     "add a watched checkmark" — the first admits several solutions, one of
     which may already half-exist. -->

## Who it affects

<!-- Just you, or anyone doing this? Which surface — desktop, TV, phone? Which
     part of the app: video, audio, emulation, readers, add-ons? A problem that
     only bites on a 10-foot TV interface gets solved differently from one that
     bites everywhere. -->

## What you tried

<!-- Existing settings, workarounds, another app that gets this right. If you
     went looking for a setting and couldn't find one, say where you looked —
     that's a finding in itself, and sometimes the feature already exists in a
     place nobody thinks to check. -->
